description: An earlier analysis proposed closing issue #2568 by retiring the legacy nightly.yml, on the grounds that every Windows leg in nightly-v2 is green. That reasoning does not hold. In nightly-v2.yml the windows-latest t3:matrix jobs only build the wheel, install it, and run the bundled dbgen and dsdgen; they do not run the unit suite. The ~32,000-test Windows run exists only in nightly.yml. Retiring nightly.yml under dlv2-70 would end Windows unit coverage without anyone deciding to. The same retirement would also delete the scheduled-workflow-liveness job, which nightly-v2 does not have. Decide between adding a Windows unit leg to nightly-v2 (after the Windows fixes land) and accepting no Windows unit coverage, and record the decision where dlv2-70 will see it.
